name: Paradox Idol
source:
Just as the idol group you manage is about to debut, one member quits. You're forced to take his place. Will you become a true K-pop idol?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
就在你担任经纪人的偶像男团即将出道之际，一名成员突然退团，迫使你不得不顶替他的位置登台。你能否成为一名真正的K-pop偶像？

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]]
